I have been using this extension in combination with the following Autohotkey script to be able to toggle the two most recent tabs with a normal Ctrl+Tab operation :)

#IfWinActive ahk_exe chrome.exe
^TAB:: Send !q
+^TAB:: Send !q
#IfWinActive
reviews.dev_reply: Nice hack, [name]!

reviews.text:
Fantastic!

After years of using Chrome, as my tab hoarding behaviour became worse and worse, I've resorted to using a tab-searching extension to find the tab I want. It worked for a while, but the limitation quickly became apparent. I'm typing up a document in one tab, and I want to find a reference that's the 99th tab out of 200 tabs. Needless to say, going back and forth was a massive chore; I would have to search for the reference tab, then the document tab... rinse and repeat.

This extension is absolutely fantastic. Plus, this way it keeps the tab-cycling ctrl+tab shortcut. I was about to switch to Firefox, but they only let you pick one or the other natively. 

Thank god for this extension!!!
reviews.dev_reply: Ah, I am glad to hear that. Thanks [name]! 🙂👍

reviews.text: Please extend to support more recent tabs!! It will be extremely good to show the history of recent tabs and allow switching between them while <alt> is being held until it is released!

This is brilliant! It works perfectly and is so much easier than the built in methods for switching between tabs in Chrome.

One thing I would like to see: Sublime Text style tab-switching. This is where hitting the toggle combo ONCE toggles between the tabs, as is current behaviour in this extension. However, subsequent taps of the combo while Alt is still held down will trigger cycling behaviour the same as using Ctrl-Tab. It's easier to understand if you download Sublime and have a play.
